channel.title: Garima Jain — stories from everywhere
channel.description: Oral histories, photo essays and field notes from the road.

item.title: What drives Yakten’s happiness index
item.description: A photo story in nine episodes from Yakten, India’s first digital nomad village near Pakyong, Sikkim: the homestays, the didis, the daajus, the pine walks, the forager, the youth, the dogs and the guests.

item.title: Told, not written: home remedies from Tamil Nadu to Kashmir
item.description: Remedies that travelled by voice, from an older person in a kitchen to a younger one — recorded across nine regions, from a Diwali jam in Tamil Nadu to a village in Uri where the road ends.

item.title: Braj: a day that refused the clock
item.description: Gokul, Barsana, Vrindavan and the Yamuna in a single day — three towns that keep a different clock, and the day I stopped wanting my own.

item.title: Nizamuddin Dargah: music, market and mannat at a living Sufi shrine
item.description: An oral history and photographic documentation — how music, faith, commerce and everyday human interaction keep Nizamuddin Dargah alive as a heritage across generations.
